layout_sources: From memory of Moje ING "Lista transakcji" CSV exports (file Lista_transakcji_nr_<10 digits>_<ddmmyy>.csv) as quoted in Polish YNAB/Firefly III discussions; not re-checked in this run: the web search budget was used up and no importer config for ING Śląski was among the sources fetched.
notes: Moje ING "Lista transakcji" CSV. Windows-1250, CRLF, semicolon-separated. About 17 rows above the table (title, document number, generation time, the user's name and address, the chosen account, the date range, the chosen categories) and a disclaimer line below it. Header row with 17 named columns and three empty ones (";;;" at the end of every table line); "Waluta" appears four times. Dates YYYY-MM-DD in "Data transakcji" and "Data księgowania"; "Kwota transakcji (waluta rachunku)" signed with a comma decimal (no thousands mark assumed); "Saldo po transakcji" after each line; account and transaction numbers prefixed with an apostrophe. Newest first. Expected dates are "Data księgowania" (the card line was made a day before). Closing = the newest balance; opening = the oldest balance minus its amount. Row count above the table and some column words are from memory.
